title: Distinguished Simple Supercuspidal Representations of $p$-adic $\text{GL}(n)$
summary: Let $\text{E}/\text{F}$ be a quadratic extension of non-archimedean local fields with odd residual characteristic. In this paper, we give equivalent conditions for a simple supercuspidal representation $π$ of $\text{GL}(n, \text{E})$ to be distinguished by $\text{GL}(n, \text{F})$ in terms of its defining maximal simple type and twisted gamma factors.
